card.name: Start of E- words, 'earth' next
card.fires_on: A capital E or hyphen-E that begins a word, often in all-caps text or a name, where the model may expect the word 'earth' or 'ear' to follow. Also fires on joining words before 'earth' sciences.

modes.label: Split-off E
modes.description: A lone E or -E starting a word, such as EAT, EYES or Zollinger-Ellison.
modes.example: DO I HAVE TO<< E>>AT MY TOMATOES?

modes.label: Hyphenated name parts
modes.description: A hyphen plus E inside a hyphenated name or translated place or person name.

modes.label: Before earth sciences
modes.description: The word 'and' right before 'earth' in a list of fields.
modes.example: associate professor of agronomy<< and>> earth and atmospheric sciences
